narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms developed across Middle Tennessee during the afternoon hours on June 12th. Some storms became severe with several reports of wind damage, hail, and flash flooding.
ev: Flood waters covered the roadway in the 700 block of Coosie Branch Road.
lsr: WATER FLOWING OVER A PORTION OF COOSIE BRANCH RD. NEAR THE 700 BLOCK.
